'''Kelnu Velus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] Velus and the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss commandos|Commando]] [[Abdan-Sho]] surveyed the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] fortifications on the [[Fest Otur Island]] north of the [[Nightmare Lands]]. They asked a Republic-aligned individual to retrieve experimental powered armor from the Gormak and destroy the power stations used to make it.<ref name="TOR" />
